messages:
maria: Hey team — Opal dedicated cutover scheduled Tue 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC. Need final thumbs on canary plan, rollback thresholds, and KMS key verify. Release note: https://console.redwood/release/OPAL-231
ops_lead_julia: Thanks — can we confirm KMS rotation isn't colliding with the customer's weekly ops window? Opal runs key rotation Fri 01:00 UTC normally.
sanjay: I checked: their rotation is Fri 01:00 but our cutover is Tue 22:00 UTC so no direct collision. Confirming model binary pinned to `redwood/model/op1:v2.3.1-rc5` for this rollout.
product_ryan: Added the detailed release notes and eval summary to the ticket — small drop in perplexity on the validation set, no behavioral regressions flagged. Link: https://issues.redwood/OPAL-231/notes
deploybot: DeployBot preflight at 2026-03-22T15:41:08Z
```
preflight: START
 - config lint: OK
 - kms-lookup: WARN (customer uses single-key alias; recommend 24h pre-rotate window)
 - model-compat: OK (quantized-int8 path validated)
 - canary-sanity: OK
preflight: COMPLETE (1 WARN)
```
oncall_ben: Ops note — we have a regional infra maintenance on Wed 23:00-23:30 UTC which could affect logging sinks. Recommend avoiding the Wed late window if any post-deploy backfills are expected. Can we keep the Tue 22:00 slot but hold for metrics stabilization until Wed 01:00?
maria: Plan proposal: 1) Canary 3% at T+0 (22:00), 2) evaluate 30 mins, if OK move to 20% at T+30m, 3) full at T+2h. Stabilization window until T+3.5h before handing to customer.
ops_lead_julia: Rollback triggers: p95 latency delta > +200ms vs baseline OR error rate > 1.5% for 5 continuous minutes OR regression alerts on our eval suite > 4% (quality). If triggered, immediate traffic revert to previous model and open a P1 channel.
sanjay: Also pin fallback: if GPU pool OOMs, route to `op1-cpu-fallback:v2.3.0` with degraded throughput. Ops runbook updated with steps and feature-flag toggle `opal_use_new_model` in the console.
product_ryan: Confirming feature flag gating and rollout notes included for customer success. Also added the customer-facing changelog snippet for the account portal.
deploybot: Scheduled deploy: opal-dedicated/tenant-221 -> model: redwood/model/op1:v2.3.1-rc5, canary: 3% -> 20% -> 100%, window: 2026-03-24T22:00:00Z. Preflight warnings persist: KMS alias single-key.
ops_lead_julia: Sanjay — can you run a quick KMS dry-run with Opal's key to confirm we can read after the pin? If there's any failure we delay and coordinate with security.
sanjay: On it. Will run dry-run and post logs in 15m.
maria: Approvals? Need 2 of 3 from ops/product/eng. Reply with :+1: to lock.
oncall_ben: :+1: from oncall — metrics hold until 01:00 UTC acknowledged.
ops_lead_julia: :+1: ops acked, will monitor the canary hook.
product_ryan: :+1: product ok with customer comms.
maria: Locking schedule. I'll send the go/no-go ping 2h prior and create the customer advisory email. DeployBot — please post a reminder 2h before start.
deploybot: Reminder scheduled at 2026-03-24T20:00:00Z. Good luck! :rocket:
